We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. No structure given. We need to get IR spectra maybe to see carbonyl stretch. Or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons. But we don't have SMILES. The system likely has a sample at hand (some unknown compound). We need to measure IR to detect C=O. Use ir_spectra tool. That will give peaks, we can count carbonyl stretches (~1700 cm-1). Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-220 ppm). Use carbon_nmr_spectra. Probably cheaper to use IR (cheaper?). Both are similar cost. Use IR first.

Let's call ir_spectra.
